facts.fact: 2026 年当下，叙述者在西雅图做儿童治疗师，最后一位来访者刚离开
facts.anchor: My last client leaves just as the sun tilts copper and metallic against the Seattle skyline.

facts.fact: 男友 James 昨晚刚求过婚，她把金戒指套在左手无名指上转
facts.anchor: I spin the gold band around my left ring finger.

facts.fact: 她试着想象自己变成 James Carmichael 的太太，却对那种生活框架提不起兴趣
facts.anchor: I try to imagine myself as a wife, no longer Ellie Mills, but Ellie Carmichael.

facts.fact: 电话那头的陌生女人叫出的是她婚前的全名
来电者是播客《The Other Grim》的主持人 Helen Ashcroft
facts.anchor: I’m Helen Ashcroft, I host a podcast called The Other Grim.

facts.fact: Helen 说 2016 年 USS Constance 号的 Elliot 船长也见过岛，Ellie 曾看过他的视频
facts.anchor: Captain Elliot of the USS Constance, who spotted the island back in 2016

facts.fact: 最新一次目击来自一艘邮轮，至少两百人同时看到那座岛
facts.anchor: at least two hundred people saw the island

facts.fact: 出发前她给 Nana 打电话，颈上挂着 Nana 在她离家上大学那天送的扇贝壳项链
facts.anchor: Nana gave me the necklace the day I left for college.

facts.fact: 她要回新斯科舍——一切开始的地方；本章末句与上一章末句同为"我回家"
